recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-35949 wording with a narrow source correction to the directly affected Measure and MeasureReport StructureDefinition elements.
issue_request: FHIR-35949 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested 0..1 string title elements on Measure.group, Measure.group.population, and Measure.group.stratifier; matching title elements on MeasureReport; and element plus $evaluate operation guidance that MeasureReport title values are copied from the corresponding Measure elements.
initial_application: Commit e58c2757d36da70026c786d4c3fa54cd908b9fb5 added the Measure and MeasureReport title elements and updated the Measure $evaluate description. Commit b5d9275fd4003241ed669da2c31381abde7bbf36 fixed a typo in the MeasureReport.group.stratifier.title element id, but current source still had a wrong Measure stratifier copied-to path and ambiguous MeasureReport title copy summaries.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current source already had the requested 0..1 string title elements and the operation-level copy instruction. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-35949 and Measure title terms found no directly relevant discussion or Confluence Jira references that would narrow or reverse the applied Jira request.
reconciliation: Changed source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml so Measure.group.stratifier.title references MeasureReport.group.stratifier.title, and changed source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml so the group, population, and stratifier title summaries explicitly state the exact Measure title element copied into each MeasureReport title. The edits do not alter element structure or cardinality.
